==================
Exit from two loops
==================

for x = 1 to 10
    for y = 1 to 10
        if x = 3 and y = 5
            exit 2
        ok
    next
next

---

(source_file

    variable: (identifier)
    (number)
    (number)
    (for_statement

      (number)
      (number)

        condition: (binary_expression
          (binary_expression
            (identifier)
            (number))
          (binary_expression
            (identifier)
            (number)))

          (number))))))

==================

next

        (identifier)
        (number))

          (identifier)))

      (binary_expression
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))))

==================
Short circuit evaluation with and
==================

x = 0 y = 10

if (x = 0 and nice()) and (y = 10 and nice())
    see "great" + nl
ok

func nice  see "nice" + nl   return 1

---

(source_file
  (expression_statement
    (assignment_expression
      (identifier)
      (number)))
  (expression_statement
    (assignment_expression
      (identifier)
      (number)))
  (if_statement
    condition: (binary_expression
      (parenthesized_expression
        (binary_expression
          (binary_expression
            (identifier)
            (number))
          (call_expression
            (identifier))))
      (parenthesized_expression
        (binary_expression
          (binary_expression
            (identifier)
            (number))
          (call_expression
            (identifier)))))
    (see_statement
      (binary_expression
        (string)
        (identifier))))
  (function_definition
    name: (identifier)
    (see_statement
      (binary_expression
        (string)
        (identifier)))
    (return_statement
      (number))))
